starting volume-network rate; region/network selection matters

agent_rules: Describe estimated active mission time separately from the live broadcasting allowance.
Allow offline participation and private proof; running out of broadcast time does not fail a mission.
After 100 verified comparable runs and at least 20 contributors, propose robust timing estimates; do not auto-tighten requirements.
Never infer total work time from a partial broadcast, a quota-truncated run, or arbitrary browser heartbeats.
Record policy version, evidence source, sample count and uncertainty. Preserve right-censored observations separately.
Viewer-minutes or delivered bytes, account-wide spend, and host time need independent controls.
Do not require someone to film beneficiaries, disclose private locations, or operate a phone while driving.
Free provider allowances are shared subsidies, not a perpetual zero wholesale price.
Credits are not mission points, transferable cash, or creator earnings. Never rescale existing balances.
